causal_estimands.trained_system_total_effect: Delta_total = L(theta_N,train_mean_message)-L(theta_R,row_real_message); theta_N and theta_R independently trained and validation-selected
causal_estimands.fixed_theta_mean_replacement: Delta_mean|R = L(theta_R,train_mean_message)-L(theta_R,row_real_message); not registered or measured in this fixed V1 matrix
causal_estimands.C1: fixed selected checkpoint branch-off vs branch-on on same gold answer, row mean NLL then mean over rows; off is no branch, not train-mean replacement
causal_estimands.DiD_scope: interaction among four trained systems; cannot derive missing fixed-theta replacement effect
causal_estimands.neutral_scope: TRAIN message-tensor mean, not scalar TRAIN pKD mean; allowed varying prompt context retained

definitions.gated_delta_norm: after gate, BF16 cast and masking, before addition to hidden; not actual h_after-h_before
definitions.position_scope: all active prompt and teacher-forced answer positions, not numeric-only
definitions.first_log_timing: forward/backward loss and total gradient norm before update; logged alpha after update; no alpha.grad recorded
definitions.C1_original: mean rows[off mean answer-token NLL-correct mean answer-token NLL]
definitions.C1_class_contribution: mean rows[(off class loss_sum-correct class loss_sum)/row full-answer token count]
definitions.class_mean: class loss_sum/class token count, nonadditive and not C1 row weighting
definitions.NLL_units: nats; mean losses nats per declared token denominator
definitions.distribution_diagnostics: post-test descriptive only: mean=sum/n; populationSD=sqrt(sum squared centered values/n), ddof0; exact parsed numeric distinct counts; no bins/new threshold
definitions.full_epoch_train_class_diagnostics: unrecorded, null; no new model evaluation

source_facts: double depth_real flips from negative(seed17) to positive(seed42)
known content_mid flips from positive(seed17) to negative(seed42)
all first-step losses equal within same seed/scenario quartet in saved logs; same recorded initialization per seed
norm scales differ strongly between early/mid at all selected checkpoints
C1 branch effect can be positive for neutral, and does not identify fixed-theta molecule-content effect
compatible_interpretations: placement interacts with training/selection trajectories and task/domain
format adaptation and coarse output distribution shifts can account for some behavior without proving molecular mechanism
hidden-scale and residual-ratio differences may affect optimization but association does not identify their causal role
unverified_hypotheses: zero-init versus alpha3 benefit pending fixed extension
balanced versus global16 allocation effect pending fixed extension
train-only representation warmup only future candidate, excluded from current36

preregister_endpoint: 冻结pKD MAE与全样本有效率；配对种子差。
